data.summary: Server._check_call returns '' for ddflow_list {kind:'nonsense'} and {limit:'banana'}: only missing/unknown arguments are refused. The spec says servers MUST validate inputs and that validation errors are tool-execution errors the model can self-correct from. Fix after MCPP-input-schema: refuse a wrong type, an out-of-enum value or an out-of-range number with the parameter's description and allowed values; regression test fails on the old code.
